name: Photo2Skin
description: AI tools for Minecraft: make a playable Minecraft skin from a photo or a description and edit it by asking, edit any Java player's skin, make Minecraft builds for Java or Bedrock, turn a photo into pixel art, turn a real place into a playable Minecraft world, and search the free skin and builds libraries. OAuth sign-in with a free Photo2Skin account; browsing and grabbing skins are free, creations spend the user's Photo2Skin credits and the server never buys anything.
author: Photo2Skin
